item.title: Hackers exploit critical Northwind VPN flaw to breach corporate networks
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting CVE-2026-90011 in Northwind VPN Gateway appliances to breach corporate networks.

item.title: Lakeshore Health ransomware attack disrupts hospital systems across three states
item.description: A ransomware attack on Lakeshore Health has forced hospitals in three states to divert ambulances.

item.title: New phishing campaign abuses calendar invites to steal cloud office logins
item.description: A phishing campaign is sending fake meeting invites that lead to credential-harvesting pages. The invites are accepted automatically by some calendar apps, so victims see them without opening an email. Researchers counted more than 300 targeted companies.
